findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: review_invoice, lookup_peppol_participant, file_to_data_inspect, file_to_data_transform, fetch_web_markdown, parse_receipt_vision · Private data: review_invoice, generate_pdf_invoice, check_peppol_ready, lookup_peppol_participant, check_payment_change, file_to_data_inspect, file_to_data_transform, monitor_sources · Public sink: generate_pdf_invoice, check_peppol_ready, lookup_peppol_participant, file_to_data_inspect, file_to_data_transform, check_vat_list, check_vat_list_format, draft_social_content · Destructive: format_peppol_invoice, verify_iban, check_peppol_ready, check_vat_list_format.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: review_invoice, lookup_peppol_participant, file_to_data_inspect, file_to_data_transform, fetch_web_markdown, parse_receipt_vision · Private data: review_invoice, generate_pdf_invoice, check_peppol_ready, lookup_peppol_participant, check_payment_change, file_to_data_inspect, file_to_data_transform, monitor_sources · Public sink: generate_pdf_invoice, check_peppol_ready, lookup_peppol_participant, file_to_data_inspect, file_to_data_transform, check_vat_list, check_vat_list_format, draft_social_content · Destructive: format_peppol_invoice, verify_iban, check_peppol_ready, check_vat_list_format

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
